I knew I was playing with fire, risking my reputation and career for moments of pleasure. But the allure was too strong to resist. I had become a slave to my nymphomania, unable to control my urges.

I knew it was wrong, but in those moments of passion, nothing else mattered. The thrill of the chase, the excitement of the forbidden, it consumed me entirely. And as I looked into the eyes of those boys, I knew they felt the same.

But deep down, I knew this couldn't last. The risks were too great, the consequences too severe. But in that moment, with my nympho desires raging out of control, I couldn't bring myself to stop. For now, I was lost in the ecstasy of the moment, with no thought for tomorrow.
